shared_elements: flat stone panel/slab surface with metal clamps or pins at edges
justification: A depicts a specific iconographic scheme: lines of inscribed letters above a large foliate cross with scrolling leaf terminals and corner acanthus-like scrolls, whereas B shows a relief of a lower garment/robe of a large figure with weapons and a band of rosettes below, plus part of an adjacent figure. The only real correspondences are non-iconographic: both are flat panels held by metal fixings and both carry incised/linear detail; the depicted subjects (an ornamental cross with text versus draped human figures and a rosette frieze) have nothing specific in common.
